title: Fit decay from a file, independently of strike gain
question: Can one shared recording importer recover a declared single-mode decay from quantized WAV at different gains and phases?
finding: The shared WAV importer and local fit recover the declared decay across gain/phase cases; silence and clipped recordings are rejected.

failedControls.outcome: rejected even when fit window is below clipping

limits: actualbytes means generated and decoded PCM WAV, not a microphone recording
Local optimization depends on supplied nominal frequency and the declared single-mode model
Fitted decay describes the recorded channel, not intrinsic material damping
Quantization-only fixtures do not validate arbitrary device recordings
